clips.title: The story
paras: In Shadowglen, young night elf priests are called to begin their training in Aldrassil. Conservator Ilthalaine passes along Shanda's message as novices learn to wield Elune's grace.

Night elf priests serve Elune as handmaidens and servants of the moon goddess. When a young kaldorei in Shadowglen shows devotion and an affinity for the divine light, Conservator Ilthalaine gives them a hallowed sigil. Shanda, the priest trainer, sent the token by messenger as an invitation to come to Aldrassil and begin spiritual training.

Shanda tells the young acolyte that unusual change has reached Teldrassil's sheltered sanctuary. Travelers fill the World Tree's boughs, including members of the wider Alliance who have leave to meet with the kaldorei. The wider world calls, but Shanda urges novices to first attend to the troubles facing Shadowglen before turning to conflicts beyond it.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our adventurer trainer, Shanda. It seems Shanda would have words with you when you have a moment. Read it and bring it to her afterwards.

clips.title: Progress
paras: It pleases me to see you've arrived so quickly, friend. Welcome.

As you've probably heard, all of Teldrassil is stirring with the comings and goings of travelers. Even members of the Alliance have even been allowed access onto Teldrassil's boughs in order to meet with other Kaldorei who prepare for the adventures ahead.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Do not concern yourself with the world below Teldrassil for now. There will be time for that later. Go now and speak to the others in Shadowglen--they can tell you more about what events have transpired. Help them in any way you can, and anytime you feel you need more training, come back to me and I will teach you what I can.
